$comment: Indicators that need a paid model run, recorded with the commit they were
measured at. measure_harness.mjs reads this file and marks an entry STALE
when HEAD has moved past that commit, so a number is never quietly carried
forward as if it were fresh.
Only record a value a command actually printed, and put that command in
`command` so anyone can reproduce it. An entry with no command is a claim,
